messages:
maya: FYI — urgent customer escalation. Refund flow picked the wrong tool and issued an invoice adjustment instead. Customer was expecting a refund for a failed charge, now they see an adjustment line and support ticket is heated. :facepalm:

maya: Quick summary from the case: customer sent amount as '£10.00' in payload. The tool autorouter returned invoice_adjust (confidence 0.62) instead of issue_refund (0.59). Logs show a schema validation failure on amount, then resolver fell back to fuzzy signature match.

jonah: Ugh. Do we have the raw request/logs?

maya: Pasted the sanitized payload we received from the app:

```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_ABC123",
  "action": "refund",
  "amount": "£10.00",
  "currency": "GBP",
  "reason": "duplicate_charge"
}
```

maya: Router log snippet: `tool_resolver: schema_validation_failed -> amount: invalid_number('£10.00') ; fallback_match: invoice_adjust (score=0.62), issue_refund (score=0.59)`

lee: That explains it. Our schema expects a numeric amount. When validation fails we currently run a fallback that considers name/signature similarity. Because the invoice_adjust signature includes a currency string and line descriptions it got a slightly higher score.

ryan: Repro steps I just ran locally: 1) curl POST to /v1/customer/action with above body 2) see 200 and routed tool name in response 3) inspect events -> `tool_executed: invoice_adjust`

ryan: Curl example I used:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/customers/actions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"customer_id":"cust_ABC123","action":"refund","amount":"£10.00","currency":"GBP"}'
```

jonah: Thanks. Short-term mitigation for support: recommend they re-send with numeric amount (pence) or remove currency symbol, e.g. `1000` for £10.00 or `10.00` with Content-Type numeric. We can also accept `amount_cents` as an alternate field in the API.

maya: Customer already received invoice_adjust. Is there a rollback or refund-after-adjust flow we can recommend? Support asked for recommended steps.

lee: We should provide a recovery doc snippet: 1) create the correct refund via issue_refund tool with numeric amount 2) link the refund to the original charge id 3) reverse the invoice adjustment if needed (create counter adjustment) — but that's manual and needs ops approval.

jonah: Long-term fix: change router behavior on schema_validation_failed to prefer same-intent tools if the root intent is explicit (payload.action == 'refund'). Also add a small normalization step that strips currency symbols and tries to coerce to number before failing validation.

ryan: I can push a small patch to the selector priority map: when fallback occurs AND request contains explicit action tokens like `refund`, bump any tool with 'refund' in signature +0.1 to avoid this tie. Will open PR.

maya: Can you also add a quick rule in support KB now so agents ask for numeric amounts first? Support is losing time.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1427 — "autoroute selected invoice_adjust for refund payload with currency symbol". Assigned to @ryan and @lee.

lee: For telemetry, please capture the exact malformed values and track how often schema_validation_failed -> fallback -> wrong_tool occurs. If rate > 0.1% over 24h, escalate to infra.

maya: Thanks team. Ryan please post PR link here and estimated ETA. Support will communicate workaround to customer in meantime. :thumbsup:
